title: The Siege of the Mite'er Family
summary: Inside the Misty Cloud Sect, a Hall of Souls envoy has used secret techniques to raise the elders Yun Du and Yun Cha to Dou Huang. Yun Shan sends them to attack the Mite'er family and hunt down the Xiao Clan. Hai Bodong fights both Dou Huangs, Tengshan takes on the elders Yun Fu and Yun Xu, and Ya Fei and Xiao Ding guard the inner courtyard. The imperial family and the Nalan Clan refuse to help, and Jia Xing Tian holds Yao Ye back from intervening. Hai Bodong is about to fall when a figure of flame saves him. It is Xiao Yan, who announces that he has come to collect the Xiao Clan's debt from the Misty Cloud Sect.
events: The Hall of Souls envoy boosts Yun Du and Yun Cha to Dou Huang
